notes.title: DUNCADE
notes.content:
You can play Duncade from the 16th of June until the 22nd of June for free! Do note that Duncade is still in development so any possible bugs may appear and everything you see may change.

You can join the Discord server to ask any questions or if you want to have a chat with the developer (Shanespeed)!

DISCORD SERVER: https://discord.gg/pZrChrb
